sections.heading: What is trending: “intelligence artificielle”
paragraphs: “intelligence artificielle” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for CA (snapshot taken 2026-10-25T11:26:58+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Atalayar, Tech Review Africa, The North Africa Post. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Morocco and AI: Who Is Accountable When the Model Enters Government?” — Atalayar
“Government Bets on AI and Digital Tools to Overhaul the Social State and Economy” — The North Africa Post

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 25 Oct 2026 03:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-25T11:26:58+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-25T11:28:13+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
